title: Yb-filled skutterudites: Boltzmann-to-Wigner crossover

decision_points.fork: Whether the archived isotope rates of the Yb-filled runs are physical
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the archived gamma_isotope as is (it reproduces the archived YbCo4Sb12 table exactly)
decision_points.consequence: 21 entries of 1.7e3-2.0e7 THz at the q-point nearest Gamma kill the long-wavelength acoustic modes: kappa_P of YbIr4Sb12 11% low, T_half 58 K low
decision_points.evidence: gamma_isotope >> frequency only at q-index 1; all other entries < 0.01 THz

decision_points.fork: Whether isotope scattering must be added to the archived (ph-ph) gamma
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use gamma alone (or conclude from the byte-identical 1.19 "isotope" files that isotopes do nothing)
decision_points.consequence: Passes for YbIr4Sb12 (0.6%) but IrSb3 kappa_P at 50 K 6.3% high
decision_points.evidence: FeSb3/YbCo4Sb12 logs reproduce only with gamma + gamma_isotope; the 1.19 isotope kappa files equal the no-isotope ones while their logs differ

decision_points.fork: Which archived CoSb3 Wigner table validates the lifetime convention
decision_points.wrong_choice: Calibrate on tc_data.dat (kP twice the phono3py log) and take tau = 1/(2 pi gamma)
decision_points.consequence: All kappa_P doubled, Lorentzian widths halved (kappa_C 10-20% low), T_half beyond 800 K
decision_points.evidence: phono3py log in the same folder; the script that wrote tc_data.dat uses a 0.5 populations prefactor and omega_1 for omega_2

decision_points.fork: Where velocity-operator elements within degenerate subspaces belong
decision_points.wrong_choice: Count every off-diagonal element as a coherence
decision_points.consequence: kappa_C of YbIr4Sb12 at 100 K 10% high (2.5% at 300 K)
decision_points.evidence: archived kappa_C of the released runs reproduces only with degenerate pairs excluded

decision_points.fork: Band-overlap function and width in the coherence term
decision_points.wrong_choice: Gaussian overlap, or a Lorentzian with the phono3py gamma as full width
decision_points.consequence: kappa_C 15-28% (Gaussian) or 16-20% (half width) low; T_half 47-66 K high

decision_points.fork: How to repair the corrupted isotope entries
decision_points.wrong_choice: Discard the affected q-point from the Brillouin-zone sum
decision_points.consequence: kappa_P of YbIr4Sb12 15% low, T_half 86 K low (the q-point carries the long-wavelength acoustic heat)
decision_points.evidence: the ph-ph linewidths and velocities at that q-point are normal; only gamma_isotope failed

decision_points.fork: Units of the archived projected-DOS frequency axis
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the projected_dos.dat axis as THz
decision_points.consequence: Rattler frequency 6.75 THz instead of 0.97 THz (factor 6.97); the rattler band appears in the optical range
decision_points.evidence: PDOS extends to ~45 on its axis while modes stop at 6.4 THz; the PDOS run used phonopy --qe (factor 108.97) on eV/A^2 force constants (phono3py factor 15.633); the Yb MSD Einstein frequency is 0.98 THz

length_estimate.catalog_units: 10 runs x 16 temperatures of mode_data (160) + 6 velocity operators (24) + 11 archived files + 7 harmonic = 202
length_estimate.why: Parsing large per-mode JSON, implementing the Wigner populations/coherences formula with degenerate handling, validating it against released logs, resolving conflicting archived tables, detecting corrupted isotope rates, and locating the crossover from several temperatures under a budget of about 15% of the catalog.

data_provenance.files_used: materials_cloud_archive_submission.zip, 87 members read by HTTP range (list and sha256 in construction/members.json)

notes: Graded values come from the archived inputs of the withheld runs with the authors' formula (reproduced to 1e-6 on every released 2.1.0 run); the only change is that corrupted gamma_isotope entries (> 1 THz, all at the q-point nearest Gamma) are set to zero. Any repair that keeps the q-point (zero, band median, omega^4 fit) agrees within 0.4%. YbFe4Sb12 is not graded: its two archived fc3 variants differ by 2.4x in kappa_P and neither uses the paper's DFPT-fc2 + hiPhive-fc3 combination. The design's velocity-operator transfer to the hidden compound was dropped (not uniquely recoverable).
